name: Records page
summary: A single-page tool over SQLite: a summary strip, a table, a form, edit and delete — the aico page runtime does the data layer. No install, no build, served the moment it is saved. The right start for trackers, registers, lists and small internal tools.
features: A summary strip that leads with the numbers
A table, a form and a two-step delete over SQLite
No install, no build: saved is served
